system.description: Usable only as your sole action on a bare-handed or melee attack, spend three Blood Traits to add your Mental Traits to your Physical Traits for the attack challenge (including bidding, ties, and overbidding); the target cannot evade with Dodge. A successful hit inflicts two additional health levels of damage, and staking attempts need only win or tie one Simple Test instead of two. Cannot be combined with attack-generating Disciplines, but may stack with non-generating enhancers like Feral Claws or Prowess.
